method: Static criterion independence audit; no configured RewardKit judge was run by this reviewer.

candidate_pair.duplicated_observable: Text readability caused solely by typeface/size/weight/letter spacing: typography explicitly owns and scores it, but overall-craft raw-5 also requires a readable interface. The prompt prohibits reusing that same observation to lower overall craft, leaving incompatible scoring directions.
candidate_pair.plausible_broken_app: An otherwise coherent app uses uniformly tiny text in the console and library while retaining consistent controls, layout and colours. Its font readability defect lowers visual_typography; the literal overall-craft anchor also denies raw 5 for the same unreadability, double charging one defect.
candidate_pair.conforming_alternative: A readable app with good type, contrast, spacing and hierarchy but inconsistent control treatments between editor and library should keep high scores on those four owned axes and lose only overall-craft credit. This shows overall craft has a separate viable target after the duplicated readability term is removed.
candidate_pair.suggested_fix: Remove readability and other owned visual properties from visual_overall_craft anchor 5; define its anchors using only cross-surface control/component consistency and unfinished details, while retaining the prompt's single-owner rule.
